sources.facts: Blackwell A/B inherit Hopper GPFIFO packing; Ada architecture inherits Ampere. This does not identify a particular Ada device's negotiated channel class.

adaptation: Portable checked C++ field packing, Hopper/Blackwell extended-base plus fetch pair, explicit little-endian serialization and format whitelist. Method headers on Hopper/Blackwell use the shared C46F UVM method macros. No upstream driver function body was copied unchanged.
additional_software_policy: Reject zero-length pushbuffer entries; explicit control NOP is separate.
Require the complete pushbuffer range to fit the 40-bit address field.
Public standalone fetch rejects Hopper/Blackwell; the paired API must establish the extended base.
Extended-base pairs admit 57-bit addresses but reject crossing a 40-bit segment and explicitly emit even a zero base.
Reject address wrap for incrementing and increment-once method packets.
Leave output unchanged on every encoding error.
